Work

SelectedProjects

EPR320 · ongoing · sole designer

PBCCO-O1000 impedance analyser front end

A DIY differential-input oscilloscope built as the measurement core of a full impedance analyser for EPR320. I am the author, designer and systems engineer. It went through several design iterations: a breadboard on lab supplies, a veroboard with a charge pump, and now a fabricated PCB.

Analogue RMS, peak and zero-crossing front end, ±8 V op-amp rails from two buck converters, an STM32 NUCLEO-L432KC, a 2.8″ ILI9341 screen and two rotary encoders for the menu.

KiCadLTspiceSTM32Analogue designJLCPCB

EPR320 · enclosure

3D-printed instrument housing

A PLA enclosure designed in Fusion for the PBCCO-O1000, now on its fourth concept. It has a single recessed front panel carrying the screen and the two encoders, ventilation, and a click-detent handle that doubles as a tilt stand.

FusionPLADesign for print

Personal · Apr 2026 – Present

Team collaboration

Pienk BCCOlifante

The Pienk BCC Olifante are a friend group of electrical engineering students at the University of Pretoria. Charl Marais and Dirk-David Krause started the group on 14 February 2024, Ulrich Snyman joined about two weeks later, and Jonathan Oliver joined on 4 March 2025.

The group studies and builds together, and puts good marks first. It is where the shared projects start, beginning with the EIR210 DC motor in May 2025. The PBCCO-O1000 for EPR320 is my own project; I am its sole author, designer and systems engineer.
